title: Source patcher
description: Build openSynth on your computer from this source archive and your unchanged Roland v5.52 ZIP.
dependencies: You also need Python with pyelftools and Capstone, and Arm GNU Toolchain 14.3.Rel1 (GCC 14.3.1).
commandLabel: Build command, run from the unzipped folder
commandNote: Replace OFFICIAL_V552_ZIP with the path to your Roland ZIP and ARM_PREFIX with your toolchain prefix, which ends in arm-none-eabi-. The output folder must be new and outside the unzipped patcher.
scope: The archive holds source code and build metadata only. Your Roland firmware stays on your computer.
